question.text: The engine of a train moving with speed $10 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ towards a platform sounds a whistle at frequency $400 \mathrm{~Hz}$. The frequency heard by a passenger inside the train is (neglect air speed. Speed of sound in air $330 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ )

solution.text: The relative velocity of a passenger with respect to source of sound (engine of train) is 0 . So there will be no Doppler's effect. So frequency heard is $400 \mathrm{~Hz}$.
